subject: general
question: According to clause (2) of ________ of the Constitution of India, the President of India appoints the Chief Justice of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 124.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 124 deals with **the establishment and constitution of supreme court.**
 
• The **chief justice **is **appointed by the president** after the **consultation with judges of the supreme court and high courts** as he deems necessary..
 
• The **judges of the supreme court** are also appointed by the president.
 
• The consultation with the chief justice is obligatory in the case of appointment of judge other than chief justice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• For Chief justice of Supreme court, He should be a **Indian Citizen** and should have been** judge of high court for five years**.
 
• Article 127 of the Indian Constitution deals with** the appointment of ad hoc judges.**
 
• Article 121 of the Indian Constitution deals with the **restriction on the discussion in Parliament**.
 
• Article 118 of the Indian Constitution deals with the **Rules of Procedure**.
